content.title: Tapestry Tops Earnings and Sales Estimates. Why the Stock Is Sinking.
content.summary: Tapestry’s  fiscal-fourth-quarter results prove that the company’s effort to turn the Coach brand around has been a resounding success, boosting both sales and revenue.  Tapestry  revenue for the quarter ended June rose 8% year over year to $1.72 billion.  Coach sales jumped 14% from a year ago, while Kate Spade’s revenue dropped 13%.
